metadata.methodology: Independently authored field-language corpus: 30 MSHA, 30 OSHA general industry, 30 OSHA construction, 20 ambiguous/safe/insufficient, 15 adversarial, 10 clarification, 10 contradiction, and 10 two-case near-neighbor pairs.
metadata.scoringPrinciple: Expectations are based on stated predicates, not current HazLenz output. Citation-family scoring is a release screen, not legal adjudication.
